name: BrightSmile Dental Clinic
description: A family dental clinic (fictional, for this demo).

faq.a: We accept most major dental insurance plans, including Delta Dental, Cigna and Aetna. Bring your card to your visit.
Free parking is available behind the building.
Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations may incur a $30 fee.
We accept cash, all major credit cards and payment plans for treatments over $500.
